title: PD-L1 22C3 LDT on VENTANA BenchMark ULTRA Automation
author: Marius MI Ilié
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ixacfie
materials: Deparaffinization, rehydration and antigen retrieval is performed by CC1 (prediluted; pH 8.0) antigen retrieval solution (Ventana Medical Systems, Roche Group, Tucson, AZ, USA), performed on the BenchMark ULTRA automated slide stainer (Ventana) for 64 minutes at 100°C (default temperature on ULTRA).
The Ventana Antibody Diluent (catalog number 251-018) should be used to dilute the primary antibody anti-PD-L1 for use on BenchMark ULTRA.

steps.title: Prepare Specimen Slides
steps.instruction: Section specimens and store them on glass slides.

substeps.instruction: Section specimens at a thickness of 3-μm.
Store slides at 4°C within 3 days after sectioning.

steps.title: Perform Automated PD-L1 Staining
steps.instruction: Run the 22C3 assay on the BenchMark ULTRA automated staining platform (Ventana).

substeps.instruction: Apply primary mouse monoclonal antibody anti-PD-L1 (Ref. M365329, Dako) at a concentration of 1:50 for 32 minutes at 37°C.
Visualize using the OptiView DAB IHC Detection Kit (Ventana) and OptiView Amplification Kit (Ventana) for 12 minutes.

steps.title: Counterstain and Coverslip
steps.instruction: Complete the staining process and prepare slides for viewing.

substeps.instruction: Counterstain specimens with Hematoxylin II and Bluing Reagent (Ventana).

steps.title: Include Assay Controls
steps.instruction: Ensure each IHC run includes the required controls.

substeps.instruction: Include a positive control (on-slide tonsil tissue).
Include a negative antibody control (buffer, no primary antibody).
